UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user account in the Bracket Battles application, storing their profile details, virtual currency balance, and security-related identifiers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, typically linked to Firebase User ID. (Primary Key)

displayName.description: The user's display name or public username.

mobileNumber.description: The user's mobile phone number, used for authentication and admin search.

deviceIds.description: An array of device IDs (e.g., IMEI/Android ID) associated with this user, for security and preventing multiple accounts per device.

virtualCurrencyBalance.description: The current balance of virtual currency ('coins') owned by the user.

referralCode.description: A unique code assigned to this user that can be shared for referrals.

referredByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who referred this user. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N UserProfile)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Tournament.title: Tournament
Tournament.description: Defines a single tournament event in the Bracket Battles app, including its schedule, rules, and prize information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tournament entity. (Primary Key)

description.description: A detailed description of the tournament, including rules and format.

status.description: The current status of the tournament (e.g., 'Upcoming', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Canceled').

startDate.description: The scheduled start date and time of the tournament.

endDate.description: The scheduled end date and time of the tournament.

entryFeeAmount.description: The amount of virtual currency required to enter the tournament.

prizePoolAmount.description: The total amount of virtual currency offered as prizes for the tournament.

registrationDeadline.description: The deadline for participants to register for the tournament.

maxParticipants.description: The maximum number of participants allowed in the tournament.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tournament was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the tournament was last updated.

PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Represents an individual competitor in a tournament, which may or may not be linked to a user account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PlayerProfile entity. (Primary Key)

name.description: The player's name or tag displayed in tournaments.

avatarUrl.description: URL to the player's avatar image.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID if this player is a registered user. Null if the player is an NPC or guest. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N PlayerProfile)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the player profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the player profile was last updated.

Team.title: Team
Team.description: Represents a team of players participating in tournaments, if the tournament format supports teams.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Team entity. (Primary Key)

logoUrl.description: URL to the team's logo image.

playerProfileIds.description: An array of PlayerProfile IDs that are members of this team. (Relationship: Team N:N PlayerProfile)

captainPlayerProfileId.description: Reference to the PlayerProfile ID of the team's captain. (Relationship: PlayerProfile 1:N Team)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the team was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the team was last updated.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Details a single match within a tournament, including participating players, scores, and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity. (Primary Key)

tournamentId.description: Reference to the Tournament ID this match belongs to. (Relationship: Tournament 1:N Match)

round.description: The round of the tournament this match is part of (e.g., 'Group Stage', 'Quarter-Finals', 'Finals').

matchNumber.description: The sequential number of the match within its round or tournament.

player1Id.description: Reference to the PlayerProfile ID of the first competitor. (Relationship: PlayerProfile 1:N Match)

player2Id.description: Reference to the PlayerProfile ID of the second competitor. (Relationship: PlayerProfile 1:N Match)

scorePlayer1.description: The current or final score of Player 1.

scorePlayer2.description: The current or final score of Player 2.

status.description: The current status of the match (e.g., 'Scheduled', 'Live', 'Completed', 'Canceled').

startTime.description: The scheduled or actual start date and time of the match.

endTime.description: The actual end date and time of the match, if completed.

winnerPlayerId.description: Reference to the PlayerProfile ID of the winning player. Null if match is ongoing, canceled, or a draw. (Relationship: PlayerProfile 1:N Match)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the match record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the match record was last updated.

Vote.title: Vote
Vote.description: Records a user's vote on a match outcome or a favorite player.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vote entity. (Primary Key)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who cast the vote. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Vote)

matchId.description: Reference to the Match ID this vote is associated with. (Relationship: Match 1:N Vote)

votedForPlayerId.description: Reference to the PlayerProfile ID that the user voted for (e.g., to win a match). (Relationship: PlayerProfile 1:N Vote)

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the vote was cast.

Referral.title: Referral
Referral.description: Tracks a referral made by one user to another, enabling rewards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Referral entity. (Primary Key)

referrerUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who made the referral. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Referral)

referredUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who was referred. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Referral)

referralDate.description: The date and time when the referral was made.

status.description: The current status of the referral (e.g., 'Pending', 'EligibleForReward', 'RewardClaimed').

rewardAmount.description: The amount of virtual currency rewarded to the referrer upon successful referral conditions.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the referral record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the referral record was last updated.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Records all financial movements of virtual currency for a user, forming their detailed ledger.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity. (Primary Key)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID associated with this transaction. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Transaction)

amount.description: The amount of virtual currency involved in the transaction. Positive for credit, negative for debit.

relatedEntityId.description: Optional reference to an ID of a related entity (e.g., 'tournamentId', 'referralId', 'offerCompletionId') providing context for the transaction. (Relationship: Transaction 1:1 Tournament/Referral/OfferCompletion)

description.description: A brief description of the transaction.

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction record was created.

OfferCompletion.title: OfferCompletion
OfferCompletion.description: Records the completion of an offer from the CPA Lead Offer Wall by a user, leading to virtual currency rewards.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OfferCompletion entity. (Primary Key)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the user who completed the offer. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N OfferCompletion)

externalOfferId.description: The identifier of the offer from the external CPA platform.

offerName.description: The name of the completed offer.

rewardAmount.description: The amount of virtual currency awarded to the user for completing the offer.

completionDate.description: The date and time when the offer was completed and verified.

status.description: The status of the offer completion (e.g., 'Pending', 'Credited', 'Rejected').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the offer completion record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the offer completion record was last updated.

AppConfiguration.title: AppConfiguration
AppConfiguration.description: Stores application-wide settings and toggles, such as maintenance mode.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppConfiguration entity. Intended as a singleton (e.g., 'appSettings'). (Primary Key)

isMaintenanceMode.description: A boolean flag indicating if the application is currently in maintenance mode.

maintenanceMessage.description: An optional message to display to users when the application is in maintenance mode.

lastUpdatedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile ID of the administrator who last updated these settings. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AppConfiguration)

lastUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when the application configuration was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. Each document ID (`userId`) corresponds to the Firebase Authentication UID. Access is restricted to the owner of the profile and administrators. This path forms the root for all user-specific subcollections.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID.

definition.description: Contains definitions for all tournaments. Publicly readable by all users, but only administrators can create, update, or delete tournament data. Uses a 'status' field for clear state management.

params.name: tournamentId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific tournament.

definition.description: Stores individual player profiles, which can represent registered users or NPCs. Publicly readable. Users can update their own player profile if the 'userId' field in the document matches their authenticated UID. Administrators can manage all player profiles.

params.name: playerProfileId
params.description: The unique identifier for a player profile.

definition.description: Stores information about player teams. Publicly readable. Only the team's captain or an administrator can update team details. This entity includes a denormalized 'captainUserId' field for authorization independence, avoiding 'get()' calls in security rules.

params.name: teamId
params.description: The unique identifier for a team.

definition.description: Subcollection under a specific tournament, detailing individual matches. Publicly readable for real-time viewing. Only administrators can create or update match scores and status.

params.name: tournamentId
params.description: The unique identifier of the parent tournament.

params.name: matchId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific match within the tournament.

definition.description: Private subcollection for each user, storing their individual votes. Only the authenticated user can read, create, or modify their own votes. 'userId' in the path ensures strict ownership.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID of the voter.

params.name: voteId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific vote.

definition.description: Tracks referral events between users. Documents contain 'referrerUserId' and 'referredUserId' for direct authorization checks, allowing both participating users to read their associated referral records. Update access is restricted to administrators or system functions.

params.name: referralId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific referral record.

definition.description: Private subcollection for each user, recording all virtual currency transactions. Only the authenticated user can read their own transaction history. 'userId' in the path ensures strict ownership.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID associated with the transaction.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific transaction.

definition.description: Private subcollection for each user, detailing completed offers from the CPA Lead Offer Wall. Only the authenticated user can read their own offer completion records. 'userId' in the path ensures strict ownership.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID of the user who completed the offer.

params.name: offerCompletionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific offer completion record.

definition.description: A singleton document storing application-wide settings like maintenance mode. Publicly readable to all users, but write access is strictly limited to administrators.

A dedicated collection for Database Access Control (DBAC). The mere existence of a document at this path signifies that the corresponding 'userId' is an administrator. Used for direct role checks in security rules without requiring 'get()' calls to other collections. Write access is restricted to other administrators.

params.name: userId
params.description: The Firebase Authentication User ID of an administrator.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling to ensure robust, debuggable security rules and efficient query patterns. Authorization Independence is achieved primarily through strategic denormalization. For instance, the 'Team' entity, which can be modified by its captain, will include a denormalized 'captainUserId' field within each 'Team' document. This field will directly store the Firebase User ID of the captain, eliminating the need for a 'get()' call to the 'PlayerProfile' document during security rule evaluation to determine ownership. This approach allows for atomic write operations and simplifies rule logic, aligning with the critical mandate.

Queryability and authorization postures (QAPs) are supported by a clear structural segregation of data. Private user-specific data, such as 'Votes', 'Transactions', and 'OfferCompletions', are strictly nested under a user's path (e.g., '/users/{userId}/votes/{voteId}'). This path-based ownership ensures that only the authenticated user ('request.auth.uid') can access their own data, enabling secure 'list' operations on these subcollections without complex filtering rules on the server side (as Firestore security rules are not filters). Publicly accessible data like 'Tournaments', 'PlayerProfiles', and 'Matches' are placed in top-level collections (e.g., '/tournaments/{tournamentId}'). These collections are designed for broad read access for all users, supporting features like 'Tournament Overview' and 'Real-time Match Viewer', while write access is strictly limited to administrators (managed via the '/roles_admin/{userId}' collection). Collaborative data like 'Referrals' are placed in a top-level collection ('/referrals/{referralId}') but include 'referrerUserId' and 'referredUserId' fields directly in the document, allowing users to query and read their related referral records directly, again avoiding 'get()' operations for authorization.
